scenes.title: The little cabin, big questions
scenes.note: A mountain discovery | 一场山间探索

beats.en: Hello, explorers! Let us ride this orange cable car.
beats.zh: 小探险家们，你们好！我们坐上这台橙色吊厢吧。

beats.en: Above the trees, with no wings and no road below!
beats.zh: 飞过树梢，却没有翅膀，下面也没有公路！

beats.en: What moves it, what holds it up, and what helps keep us safe?
beats.zh: 什么让它前进？什么把它托住？又有哪些办法保障安全？

scenes.title: One rope, one big loop
scenes.note: Top view, simplified | 简化俯视图

beats.en: From above, one rope forms a loop around two big wheels.
beats.zh: 从上面看，一根绳索绕过两个大轮，组成一个环。

beats.en: One side goes toward the mountain. The other returns.
beats.zh: 一侧朝山上移动，另一侧向回程移动。

beats.en: The wheels turn, the loop moves, and the attached cabins travel with it.
beats.zh: 大轮转动，绳环移动，夹在绳上的吊厢也跟着移动。

scenes.title: The station does the pulling
scenes.note: Motor → wheel → rope → cabin | 电机 → 大轮 → 绳索 → 吊厢

beats.en: An electric motor in a station turns a large drive wheel.
beats.zh: 车站里的电动机带动一个大驱动轮。

beats.en: The rope presses against the wheel. Friction helps the wheel move the rope.
beats.zh: 钢丝绳压在大轮上，摩擦力帮助大轮带动绳索。

beats.en: One drive moves many cabins. Each cabin does not need a driving engine.
beats.zh: 一套驱动带动许多吊厢，每个吊厢无需各装一台驱动发动机。

scenes.title: Our rope has two jobs
scenes.note: Carry + pull | 承载 + 牵引

beats.en: Our example is a single-rope, circulating, detachable gondola. What a name!
beats.zh: 我们的例子叫单线循环脱挂式吊厢索道。好长的名字！

beats.en: Here, the same rope supports the cabins and pulls them along.
beats.zh: 在这种索道里，同一根钢丝绳既承载吊厢，也牵引吊厢。

beats.en: Two jobs: carry the weight, and make the journey.
beats.zh: 两份工作：承受重量，带着吊厢前进。

scenes.title: A rope made of many wires
scenes.note: Wires → strands → rope | 钢丝 → 绳股 → 钢丝绳

beats.en: This is not a piece of string. Many steel wires twist into strands.
beats.zh: 它不是普通细绳。许多钢丝拧成一股股绳股。

beats.en: Strands surround a core, making a strong rope that can bend.
beats.zh: 绳股围绕绳芯，组成结实又能弯曲的钢丝绳。

beats.en: Strong is not unbreakable. Experts must keep checking its condition.
beats.zh: 结实不等于不会损坏，专业人员必须持续检查它的状态。

scenes.title: Why is the rope a little curved?
scenes.note: Controlled tension, natural sag | 合适的张力，自然的垂度

beats.en: Weight curves the rope between supports. We call this sag.
beats.zh: 重量让支点之间的绳索下弯，这叫垂度。

beats.en: A tensioning system keeps the rope pulled within its designed range.
beats.zh: 张紧系统把钢丝绳的拉紧程度保持在设计范围内。

beats.en: Too loose or too tight causes problems. Engineers calculate the balance.
beats.zh: 太松、太紧都有问题，工程师会计算合适的平衡。

scenes.title: The towers lend a hand
scenes.note: Turning sheaves guide the rope | 转动的托索轮引导钢丝绳

beats.en: Towers hold groups of small grooved wheels, called sheaves.
beats.zh: 支架上装着一组组带凹槽的小轮，叫托索轮。

beats.en: These support and guide the moving rope across the hillside.
beats.zh: 这些小轮支撑并引导山坡上的移动钢丝绳。

beats.en: The wheels turn with the rope, reducing rubbing. The cabin hangs below its grip.
beats.zh: 小轮随着绳索转动，减少滑动摩擦。吊厢悬挂在抱索器下面。

scenes.title: Meet the grip
scenes.note: A spring-loaded mechanical clamp | 用弹簧夹紧的机械夹具

beats.en: A mechanical clamp called a grip joins our cabin to the rope.
beats.zh: 一种叫抱索器的机械夹具，把吊厢连到绳索上。

beats.en: In our example, strong springs press the grip closed around the rope.
beats.zh: 在我们的例子里，有力的弹簧让抱索器夹紧钢丝绳。

beats.en: The closed grip moves with the rope. It stays closed outside the stations.
beats.zh: 夹紧的抱索器随着绳索移动，在车站外保持夹紧。

scenes.title: Where does the weight go?
scenes.note: Cabin → hanger → grip → rope → supports | 一条承载路径

beats.en: Earth's gravity pulls the cabin downward. Follow the path that supports its weight.
beats.zh: 地球的重力把吊厢向下拉。来看看重量怎样被支撑。

beats.en: From cabin to hanger, from hanger to grip, and from grip to rope.
beats.zh: 从吊厢到吊杆，从吊杆到抱索器，再从抱索器到钢丝绳。

beats.en: Forces pass to towers and stations, then through their foundations to the ground.
beats.zh: 力传给支架和车站，再经它们的基础传到地面。

scenes.title: Fast outside, slow inside?
scenes.note: Think about it! | 想一想！

beats.en: A puzzle! Cabins travel quickly outside, but slowly inside the station.
beats.zh: 谜题来了！吊厢站外走得快，站内走得慢。

beats.en: How can one cabin slow down while the rope keeps moving?
beats.zh: 钢丝绳继续移动，一个吊厢怎么能单独慢下来？

beats.en: Watch the grip, and watch what supports the cabin.
beats.zh: 盯住抱索器，也看看什么在支撑吊厢。

scenes.title: Support first, then release
scenes.note: The station rail supports the carrier | 站内轨道接住吊厢组件

beats.en: As the cabin enters, its carrier wheels run onto a station rail.
beats.zh: 吊厢进入车站时，吊厢组件上的行走轮驶上站内轨道。

beats.en: That rail supports the cabin before a mechanism opens the grip.
beats.zh: 轨道先支撑住吊厢，然后机械装置才打开抱索器。

beats.en: It leaves the rope, but still has support. It never floats freely.
beats.zh: 它离开绳索，但仍有支撑，绝不是自由悬空。

scenes.title: Two speeds in one station
scenes.note: Fast rope / slow cabin | 绳索快，吊厢慢

beats.en: Rows of turning tires move the cabin along the station rail.
beats.zh: 一排排转动的轮胎，带着吊厢沿站内轨道前进。

beats.en: The tires move it slowly for boarding, while the steel rope keeps moving.
beats.zh: 轮胎让吊厢慢慢移动，方便上下客；钢丝绳继续运行。

beats.en: Inside this station, the cabin and the steel rope can move at different speeds.
beats.zh: 在车站里，吊厢和钢丝绳可以以不同的速度移动。

scenes.title: Ready to join the rope again
scenes.note: Accelerate → clamp → check | 加速 → 夹紧 → 检查

beats.en: After boarding, the doors close and the tires speed the cabin up.
beats.zh: 乘客上车后，厢门关闭，轮胎带着吊厢加速。

beats.en: Near the rope speed, the grip closes onto the rope again.
beats.zh: 接近钢丝绳的速度时，抱索器重新夹住绳索。

beats.en: Checks confirm correct gripping. If something is wrong, the system stops.
beats.zh: 检查确认是否正确夹紧，发现问题，系统就停下。

scenes.title: A station along the way

beats.en: Some longer routes have an intermediate station: a stop partway along.
beats.zh: 有些较长的索道，会在途中设中间站。

beats.en: Rails support the cabin. Its grip opens, and tires move it slowly through the station.
beats.zh: 轨道先接住吊厢。抱索器打开，轮胎带着它在站内慢慢走。

beats.en: Here, a conveyor takes the same cabin between two separate rope loops.
beats.zh: 这个例子有两段独立绳环。输送装置把同一吊厢送到下一段。

beats.en: It speeds up, grips the next rope, and is checked before leaving.
beats.zh: 吊厢加速，夹住下一段钢丝绳，检查合格后才出站。

beats.en: Designs differ. Some stations share one rope; other routes require changing cabins.
beats.zh: 设计也有不同：有的站共用一根绳环，有的线路需要换乘吊厢。

scenes.note: 同一吊厢，跨两段绳环 | Same cabin, two rope sections

scenes.title: Where may the grip open?
scenes.note: A: on the line / B: in the station | A：站外线路 / B：站内

beats.en: Your turn! Does the grip open above the trees, or inside the station?
beats.zh: 轮到你了！抱索器在树梢上方打开，还是在车站里打开？

beats.en: Think about the support we just saw.
beats.zh: 想一想，我们刚才看到了什么支撑。

beats.en: Inside the station! A rail supports the cabin before it leaves the rope.
beats.zh: 在车站里！吊厢脱离绳索之前，轨道已经把它接住了。

scenes.title: A family of different ropeways
scenes.note: Our example is only one type | 本片主角只是其中一种

beats.en: Other ropeways may use separate ropes for carrying and pulling.
beats.zh: 其他索道可能用不同的绳索分别承载和牵引。

beats.en: Some large cars travel back and forth, instead of around a loop.
beats.zh: 有些大车厢来回往返，而不是绕环循环。

beats.en: Appearance cannot tell you everything. Each system has its own equipment and instructions.
beats.zh: 外形不能说明一切，每个系统都有自己的设备和乘坐规定。

scenes.title: Safety is a team
scenes.note: Design · check · monitor · stop · respond | 多层保障

beats.en: Safety needs several layers working together, not one magic part.
beats.zh: 安全需要多层措施一起工作，不是靠一个神奇零件。

beats.en: Design, inspection, sensors, brakes, trained people, and emergency plans each help.
beats.zh: 设计、检查、传感器、制动器、受训人员和应急计划，各有作用。

beats.en: These reduce risk. Correct operation and maintenance are still essential.
beats.zh: 它们降低风险，正确操作和维护仍然必不可少。

scenes.title: Built for planned loads
scenes.note: Respect the posted limits | 遵守现场限载规定

beats.en: Engineers calculate the forces from passengers, the rope, movement, and weather.
beats.zh: 工程师计算乘客、绳索、运动和天气带来的力。

beats.en: Parts need extra strength beyond normal loads, following the rules for their system.
beats.zh: 按该系统的要求，部件需要高于正常载荷的额外强度。

beats.en: Extra strength is no excuse to overload. Follow the posted loading limits.
beats.zh: 额外强度不是超载的理由，要遵守现场限载规定。

scenes.title: Looking outside, looking inside
scenes.note: Visual inspection + magnetic testing | 目视检查 + 磁性检测

beats.en: Trained inspectors look for wear, damage, corrosion, and changes in the rope.
beats.zh: 受训检查人员寻找钢丝绳的磨损、损伤、锈蚀和变化。

beats.en: Magnetic equipment helps find broken wires, including damage hidden inside.
beats.zh: 磁性设备帮助发现断丝，包括内部隐藏的损伤。

beats.en: Results guide repairs and replacement. Looking strong is not enough.
beats.zh: 结果帮助决定维修或更换，光看起来结实还不够。

scenes.title: Checks before the first ride
scenes.note: Maintenance is part of the journey | 维护也是旅程的一部分

beats.en: Before passengers arrive, staff carry out the checks required for their ropeway.
beats.zh: 乘客到来之前，工作人员按该索道的要求进行检查。

beats.en: Grips, wheels, brakes, doors, and controls need regular checking and testing.
beats.zh: 抱索器、轮子、制动器、厢门和控制设备都需定期检查、测试。

beats.en: Records help reveal changes. Maintenance is part of safety.
beats.zh: 记录帮助发现变化，维护本身就是安全保障的一部分。

scenes.title: The system has watchful helpers
scenes.note: Speed · grip · rope position | 速度 · 夹紧状态 · 绳索位置

beats.en: Sensors check rope speed, rope position, and correct gripping.
beats.zh: 传感器检查绳速、绳索位置，以及是否正确夹紧。

beats.en: Signals go to the controls. Staff also watch the information.
beats.zh: 信号传到控制系统，工作人员也查看信息。

beats.en: Sensors cannot do everything. Equipment and trained people work together.
beats.zh: 传感器不能包办一切，设备和受训人员要共同配合。

scenes.title: A warning can mean STOP
scenes.note: Detect → stop → investigate | 发现 → 停车 → 查明原因

beats.en: A safety problem can stop the drive and apply the brakes.
beats.zh: 安全异常可以让驱动停止，并施加制动。

beats.en: For example, a grip that is not correctly closed must not leave the station.
beats.zh: 例如抱索器没有正确夹紧，就不能让它出站。

beats.en: Staff fix the cause before restarting. Stopping can protect passengers.
beats.zh: 工作人员处理原因后才能重启，停车可以保护乘客。

scenes.title: What stops the moving loop?
scenes.note: Service brake + emergency brake | 工作制动 + 紧急制动

beats.en: The drive has brakes. A service brake controls stopping.
beats.zh: 驱动装置设有制动器，工作制动控制停车。

beats.en: A separate emergency brake can act directly on the large drive wheel.
beats.zh: 另有紧急制动器，可以直接作用在大驱动轮上。

beats.en: Brakes control the loop. Not every cabin has its own rope brake.
beats.zh: 制动器控制绳环，并非每个吊厢都有自己的绳索制动器。

scenes.title: A brake that wants to close
scenes.zh_title: 倾向于自动合上的制动器
scenes.note: Spring applied / power released | 弹簧施加制动，动力保持释放

beats.en: Many ropeway brakes use springs to press the brake pads closed.
beats.zh: 许多索道制动器用弹簧压紧制动垫。

beats.en: During operation, powered equipment holds the brake open.
beats.zh: 运行时，动力设备把制动器保持在释放状态。

beats.en: Lose that releasing power, and the springs can apply the brake.
beats.zh: 释放制动的动力消失时，弹簧就能施加制动。

scenes.title: Stopping is not falling
scenes.note: The closed grip still supports the cabin | 抱索器仍然夹紧

beats.en: When the rope stops, the cabin is still supported by its closed grip and the rope.
beats.zh: 钢丝绳停止时，吊厢仍由夹紧的抱索器和钢丝绳支撑。

beats.en: A hanging cabin may sway a little as movement changes. Staff monitor the situation.
beats.zh: 运动状态变化时，悬挂的吊厢可能轻微晃动，工作人员会监测情况。

beats.en: Braking controls movement. It cannot replace checking the rope and other parts.
beats.zh: 制动控制运动，不能代替检查绳索和其他部件。

scenes.title: When the mountain gets windy
scenes.note: Conditions change; limits vary | 天气会变化，不同系统限值不同

beats.en: Wind can push a cabin sideways. Operators monitor weather and wind along the route.
beats.zh: 风会把吊厢向侧面推，运营人员要监测线路上的天气和风况。

beats.en: They may slow down, stop boarding, or suspend operation when needed.
beats.zh: 必要时，他们可能减速、停止上客，或暂停运行。

beats.en: Wind limits differ between systems. Follow staff, not a guessed limit.
beats.zh: 不同系统的风速限值不同，要听从工作人员，不能自己猜。

scenes.title: What if the power goes out?
scenes.note: Assess first, then use the right plan | 先判断，再执行合适方案

beats.en: First, the system stops and the team checks what has happened.
beats.zh: 首先，系统停下，团队检查发生了什么。

beats.en: Many systems have a backup drive, used only when moving cabins is safe.
beats.zh: 许多系统设有备用驱动，只能在确认吊厢能安全移动时使用。

beats.en: It cannot solve every problem. Staff choose the right emergency plan.
beats.zh: 它不能解决所有问题，工作人员要选择正确的应急方案。

scenes.title: A plan, a team, and practice
scenes.note: Rescue methods depend on the installation | 救援方式取决于具体索道

beats.en: If moving the rope is unsafe, trained teams follow a planned rescue procedure.
beats.zh: 如果移动绳索不安全，受训团队就执行预先制定的救援程序。

beats.en: Methods depend on the system, terrain, and conditions. Teams practice for emergencies.
beats.zh: 方式取决于系统、地形和现场情况，团队会进行应急演练。

beats.en: Passengers wait for instructions. Never try to climb out or rescue yourself.
beats.zh: 乘客应等待指示，绝不能自行爬出或尝试自救。

scenes.title: You are part of the safety team
scenes.zh_title: 你也是安全团队的一员
scenes.note: Stay with your grown-up | 和大人一起行动

beats.en: Your job begins at the station. Stay with your grown-up, and follow the attendant.
beats.zh: 你的任务从车站开始：跟紧大人，听从工作人员指引。

beats.en: Wait your turn. Walk carefully, and keep hands away from doors and moving equipment.
beats.zh: 按顺序等候，小心走动，双手远离厢门和运动设备。

beats.en: Follow loading instructions. Enjoy the adventure through the windows!
beats.zh: 遵守上车和限载指引，透过窗户欣赏美景吧！

scenes.title: A calm cabin is a happy cabin
scenes.note: Do not rock or force the doors | 不故意摇晃，不强开厢门

beats.en: Inside, sit or stand as the operator instructs, and keep your body inside the cabin.
beats.zh: 进厢后，按现场规定坐好或站稳，身体保持在吊厢内。

beats.en: Do not rock the cabin, lean out, or force the doors open.
beats.zh: 不故意摇晃吊厢，不探出身体，不强行打开厢门。

beats.en: Worried? Tell your grown-up. Follow the posted instructions to contact staff.
beats.zh: 如果担心，告诉大人，按标示的指引联系工作人员。

scenes.title: If your cabin pauses
scenes.note: Stay calm · listen · wait | 保持冷静 · 留意通知 · 等待指示

beats.en: A pause alone cannot explain the cause. Listen for announcements.
beats.zh: 单凭暂停不能解释原因，请留意通知。

beats.en: Stay with your grown-up, keep the doors closed, and wait for instructions.
beats.zh: 和大人待在一起，保持厢门关闭，等待工作人员指示。

beats.en: Need help? Use the posted emergency contact. Never jump or climb out.
beats.zh: 需要帮助？使用标示的紧急联系方式，绝不能跳出或自行爬出。

scenes.title: What would you do?
scenes.note: A: climb out / B: wait and listen | A：爬出去 / B：等待并听通知

beats.en: Your cabin pauses. Do you climb out, or stay inside and listen?
beats.zh: 吊厢暂停了，你是爬出去，还是留在里面听通知？

beats.en: Give your answer to your grown-up.
beats.zh: 把你的答案告诉身边的大人。

beats.en: Stay inside and listen! The trained team decides what should happen next.
beats.zh: 留在里面听通知！接下来如何处理，由受训团队来判断。

scenes.title: Six jobs behind the journey
scenes.note: Carry · pull · grip · guide · check · stop | 承载 · 牵引 · 夹紧 · 引导 · 检查 · 制动

beats.en: Let us put the story together. The rope carries and pulls. The grip connects the cabin.
beats.zh: 把故事连起来：钢丝绳负责承载和牵引，抱索器把吊厢连上绳索。

beats.en: Towers guide the rope. Station rails and tires let cabins slow down for boarding.
beats.zh: 支架引导绳索，站内轨道和轮胎让吊厢减速，方便上下客。

beats.en: Checks, brakes, weather decisions, and trained teams help protect the whole journey.
beats.zh: 检查、制动、天气判断和受训团队，共同保障整趟旅程。

scenes.title: Now you can explain it!
scenes.note: Keep asking good questions | 继续提出好问题

beats.en: Next time you see a cable car, look for the rope, towers, and station.
beats.zh: 下次看到索道，找一找钢丝绳、支架和车站。

beats.en: Can you explain what pulls the cabin, and why it slows in the station?
beats.zh: 你能解释什么牵引吊厢，以及它为什么在站内减速吗？

beats.en: You have discovered how this cable car works. Stay curious, follow the rules, and enjoy the view!
beats.zh: 你已经发现了索道的运行秘密。保持好奇，遵守规定，欣赏风景吧！

scenes.title: A few notes for grown-ups
scenes.note: Sources and full bilingual script accompany this film | 完整资料与双语脚本随片提供

S1.title: LEITNER: Detachable gondola lifts
S1.supports: Monocable carrying/hauling rope; station detachment and lower station speed; normally closed LPA grip and departure checks.

S2.title: LEITNER: Types of ropeway
S2.supports: Closed circulation vs reversible ropeways; monocable, bicable and tricable layouts.

S3.title: LEITNER: Drive system
S3.supports: Station motor, drive, two braking systems and emergency drive; smooth starts/stops.

S4.title: EMSD: Design, manufacture and installation code (2018)
S4.supports: Loads and tension; service/emergency braking, spring application, safety trips, backup drives and planned rescue. Regional code used as a technical example, not a universal legal statement.
